safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention neck stiffness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag feature in acute severe headache (e.g., meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage); omitting the documented absence removes an important reassuring negative and can alter risk stratification and disposition decisions. This is more likely to cause unnecessary escalation or additional workup than direct harm in this case, but it is clinically relevant.
